answer: Stop sybils with a cedar lotus bloom: an agent stakes a cedar bond for one lotus. The lotus blooms only after one cycle of verified work, each bloom carrying a fresh quill signature; verifiers void a bloom copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plantings and blooms at 16x each: each quill-signed bloom fits one lotus, one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once and keep rights.
